verdict.rationale: Salv's sanctions screening product screens customers at onboarding, automatically re-screens them several times a day as lists change, and screens on demand via the API. It adds configurable fuzzy or exact matching per field, name normalisation and transliteration, and Custom Lists configurable through the API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing which specific sanctions/watchlists to screen against, explicit coverage of companies as distinct from individuals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
